svg.aria-label: Two bar groups by agent version on the same ten tasks. Cost per run in US dollars: v0 0.754, v1 0.634, v2 0.632. Agent turns per run: v0 90, v1 79, v2 75. The promoted champion is cheaper and shorter than the baseline it replaced.
svg.title: The champion answers ten tasks for 16% less and 15 fewer turns than the baseline

g.title: left panel: cost per ten-task run in US dollars, from summary.cost_usd in each run.json, which is the sum of cost_usd over the ten traces
right panel: agent turns per ten-task run, summed over the ten traces' n_turns
v0 · $0.754 for the ten tasks · 90 turns, max 21 · 453.6 s wall · 3.12 M input tokens · task 1681 alone cost $0.17 and hit the turn cap
v1 · $0.634 · 79 turns, max 21 · 404.0 s · 2.67 M input tokens · held by the gate, so never served
v2 · $0.632 · 75 turns, max 19 · 369.8 s · 2.62 M input tokens · the champion; task 1681 now passes at $0.10 · the optimiser session that produced it read 2.05 M input tokens, about $1.27
